origin.sandevistan_origin.sandevistan.de: A street runner with a Dynalar Sandevistan implanted in the spine. The world crawls while you move at full speed.
power.sandevistan_origin.sandevistan_tog: Toggle the implant (primary ability key). Time slows down within 15 blocks around you, you gain speed, a widened field of view and leave rainbow afterimages. Running it too long (about 30 s) overheats the implant: it shuts down, hurts you and locks for 15 s. Needs food above 3 drumsticks.
power.sandevistan_origin.cyberware_strai: The implant takes its toll: you have 2 fewer hearts. Using it burns hunger fast.
